roughVizR

An R interface to the roughViz.js library for creating hand-drawn, sketchy styled charts.

Create beautiful hand-drawn style charts directly in R! This package provides R bindings for the popular roughViz.js library, allowing you to create sketchy, artistic visualizations with a hand-drawn aesthetic.

Installation 

# Install from GitHub
devtools::install_github("ashgreat/roughVizR")

# Or install the development branch explicitly
remotes::install_github("ashgreat/roughVizR", ref = "main")

Usage

Basic Bar Chart 

library(roughVizR)

# Create sample data
data <- data.frame(
  labels = c("North", "South", "East", "West"),
  values = c(10, 5, 8, 3)
)

# Create a rough bar chart
roughBar(
  data = data,
  labels = "labels",
  values = "values",
  title = "Regional Sales",
  color = "coral",
  roughness = 2,
  fillStyle = "cross-hatch"
)

Pie Chart 

# Create pie chart data
pie_data <- data.frame(
  labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
  values = c(30, 20, 25, 25)
)

roughPie(
  data = pie_data,
  labels = "labels",
  values = "values",
  title = "Distribution",
  colors = c("#ff6b6b", "#4ecdc4", "#45b7d1", "#f9ca24")
)

Line Chart 

# Create line chart data
line_data <- data.frame(
  x = 1:10,
  y = c(3, 7, 2, 9, 4, 6, 8, 5, 10, 3),
  y2 = c(5, 2, 8, 3, 7, 4, 9, 6, 2, 8)
)

roughLine(
  data = line_data,
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  y2 = "y2",
  title = "Trend Analysis",
  colors = c("coral", "skyblue"),
  circle = TRUE,
  circleRadius = 8
)

Scatter Plot 

# Create scatter plot data
scatter_data <- data.frame(
  x = rnorm(50, mean = 50, sd = 10),
  y = rnorm(50, mean = 30, sd = 5),
  group = sample(c("A", "B", "C"), 50, replace = TRUE)
)

roughScatter(
  data = scatter_data,
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  colorVar = "group",
  title = "Random Distribution",
  colors = c("#ff6b6b", "#4ecdc4", "#45b7d1"),
  radius = 10
)

Donut Chart 

roughDonut(
  data = pie_data,
  labels = "labels",
  values = "values",
  title = "Donut Distribution",
  colors = c("#ff6b6b", "#4ecdc4", "#45b7d1", "#f9ca24"),
  roughness = 3
)

Horizontal Bar Chart 

roughBarH(
  data = data,
  labels = "labels",
  values = "values",
  title = "Horizontal Bars",
  color = "pink",
  fillStyle = "zigzag"
)

Stacked Bar Chart 

# Create stacked bar data
stacked_data <- data.frame(
  labels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"),
  ProductA = c(20, 30, 25, 35),
  ProductB = c(15, 20, 18, 22),
  ProductC = c(10, 15, 12, 18)
)

roughStackedBar(
  data = stacked_data,
  labels = "labels",
  title = "Quarterly Sales by Product",
  colors = c("#ff6b6b", "#4ecdc4", "#45b7d1")
)

Function overview

Function Description Key arguments
roughBar() Vertical sketchy bar chart. data, labels, values, color, titleAlign
roughBarH() Horizontal variant of roughBar(). data, labels, values, margin
roughStackedBar() Stacked column chart for parts-of-a-whole. data, labels, colors
roughDonut() Donut chart with optional legend. data, labels, values, colors, legendPosition
roughPie() Pie chart wrapper around roughDonut(). data, labels, values, colors
roughLine() Single or multi-series line chart. data, x, y, y2, circle
roughScatter() Scatter plot with optional grouping. data, x, y, colorVar, radius
roughViz() Low-level widget constructor used by helpers. chartType, config, width, height
roughVizOutput() UI placeholder for Shiny apps. outputId, width, height
renderRoughViz() Server-side renderer for Shiny. expr, env, quoted

Chart Options

Common Options

  • roughness: Controls how rough the drawing is (0-10, default: 1)
  • fillStyle: Style of fill (‘hachure’, ‘cross-hatch’, ‘zigzag’, ‘dashed’, ‘solid’, ‘zigzag-line’)
  • fillWeight: Weight of fill lines
  • strokeWidth: Width of stroke
  • bowing: How much the lines bow (default: 0)
  • font: Font style (0 = ‘gaegu’, 1 = ‘indie flower’, 2 = custom)
  • title: Chart title
  • margin: Margins (list with top, right, bottom, left)

Using with Shiny 

library(shiny)
library(roughVizR)

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("roughViz in Shiny"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      sliderInput("roughness", "Roughness:", min = 0, max = 10, value = 2),
      selectInput("fillStyle", "Fill Style:",
                  choices = c("hachure", "cross-hatch", "zigzag", "dashed", "solid"),
                  selected = "hachure")
    ),
    mainPanel(
      roughVizOutput("chart")
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$chart <- renderRoughViz({
    data <- data.frame(
      labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
      values = c(10, 5, 8, 3)
    )
    
    roughBar(
      data = data,
      labels = "labels",
      values = "values",
      title = "Interactive Chart",
      roughness = input$roughness,
      fillStyle = input$fillStyle
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
